items.t: Trump seeks 'permanent' Iran deal, says no rush
items.d: Trump said any deal must stop Iran ever getting a nuclear weapon, but he could wait until 2027. Tankers were hit near Hormuz as the strait stays shut.

items.t: Trump and Xi back human control of military AI
items.d: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the two leaders agreed AI must not make military decisions without humans involved, a rare joint limit on AI in warfare.

items.t: US tech stocks suffer worst week since Covid
items.d: AI doubts drove a steep sell-off: the Nasdaq fell over 5% on Friday and chipmakers slumped, pushing tech shares toward a bear market despite Anthropic's listing.

items.t: NATO stands with Poland after Russian missiles land
items.d: Two Russian missiles and a drone fell in south-east Poland during an attack on Ukraine. Tusk called it a deliberate provocation; analysts doubt NATO's Article 5 will be used.

items.t: Violence in Sinaloa after 'El Chapo Isidro' capture
items.d: Mexican forces caught FBI most-wanted cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores; burning cars, blockades and deadly clashes followed in Sinaloa.

items.t: Anthropic valued near $1.8 trillion after record IPO
items.d: The Claude maker's stock debut was the biggest AI listing yet, but it could not stop the wider market slide that followed.

items.t: Bank of Canada raises interest rates
items.d: Canada's central bank lifted its key rate as inflation stays stubborn, joining others signalling tighter policy rather than cuts.

items.t: John Deere buys farm-AI firm Orchard Robotics
items.d: The tractor giant is buying the start-up, whose camera systems count and map fruit, to expand precision tools for orchards and vineyards.

items.t: Report: Nvidia sought chip exports to China military-linked firms
items.d: A report says Nvidia pursued AI chip sales to companies tied to China's military, adding pressure as Washington tightens export controls.

items.t: Bell Canada says 'agentic' AI hacker stole data
items.d: The telecom firm said an attacker using autonomous AI tools took enterprise customer data in a breach on 17 November.

items.t: AI agents found zero-day in medical imaging server
items.d: Attackers' AI agents discovered an unknown flaw in the MONAI Label medical-imaging tool, a sign AI is speeding up real-world hacking.

items.t: BADBOX botnet returns with 40bn daily ad requests
items.d: The malware network, hidden in cheap Android TV boxes and gadgets, is back at record scale for ad fraud. Avoid unbranded streaming boxes.

items.t: SpaceX launches spy satellites for US NRO
items.d: A Falcon 9 carried another batch of National Reconnaissance Office satellites from California, part of a fast-growing US surveillance constellation.

items.t: US measles cases hit highest level since 1991
items.d: Nearly 5,840 confirmed cases have been reported in 2026, as falling vaccination rates let outbreaks spread.

items.t: AI video spots early delirium in ICU patients
items.d: Stanford researchers built a camera system that watches ICU patients and flags early signs of delirium, which staff often miss.

items.t: AI predicts three pregnancy complications early
items.d: Kaiser Permanente models flag risks such as pre-eclampsia earlier in pregnancy, giving doctors more time to act.

items.t: Burnham to meet Birmingham pub bombings families
items.d: The PM pledged to meet relatives of the 21 killed in 1974, who want a judge-led public inquiry; talks are expected early in the new year.

items.t: Hundreds march in London for tougher AI rules
items.d: Protesters marched to Downing Street on Saturday, citing scientists' warnings about the risks of advanced AI.

items.t: UK borrowing hits £17bn in October
items.d: It was the third-highest October on record, with £11.2bn spent on debt interest, squeezing the Chancellor's room before the budget.

items.t: 特朗普稱要與伊朗達「永久」協議 不急於行動
items.d: 特朗普表示任何協議須永久阻止伊朗擁核，但可等到2027年才決定下一步。霍爾木茲海峽仍然封閉，附近有油輪遇襲。

items.t: 特朗普與習近平同意軍用AI須由人類把關
items.d: 美國財長貝森特表示，兩國領導人同意軍事決策不能交由AI獨自作出，是中美罕有就戰爭中使用AI設限。

items.t: 美國科技股錄得新冠疫情以來最差一周
items.d: 市場對AI前景存疑引發拋售，納指周五跌逾5%，晶片股急挫，科技股逼近熊市，Anthropic上市亦未能扭轉跌勢。

items.t: 北約力撐波蘭 俄導彈落入波蘭境內
items.d: 俄羅斯空襲烏克蘭期間，兩枚導彈及一架無人機墮落波蘭東南部。總理圖斯克斥為蓄意挑釁，分析認為北約不大可能啟動第五條。

items.t: 「El Chapo Isidro」落網 錫那羅亞爆發暴力
items.d: 墨西哥部隊拘捕美國聯邦調查局頭號通緝毒梟梅薩弗洛雷斯，錫那羅亞州隨即出現焚車、路障及致命衝突。

items.t: Anthropic破紀錄上市 市值近1.8萬億美元
items.d: Claude開發商Anthropic上市為史上最大AI企業招股，但未能阻止其後大市下滑。

items.t: 加拿大央行加息
items.d: 加拿大央行因通脹頑固上調基準利率，與其他央行一樣轉向收緊而非減息。

items.t: John Deere收購農業AI公司Orchard Robotics
items.d: 農機巨頭收購這家以鏡頭點算及繪製果實分佈的初創，擴展果園及葡萄園的精準農業工具。

items.t: 報道指Nvidia曾尋求向與中國軍方有關公司出口晶片
items.d: 報道指Nvidia曾爭取向與中國軍方有關連的公司出售AI晶片，在美國收緊出口管制下令公司承受更大壓力。

items.t: 加拿大Bell指AI代理駭客盜取客戶資料
items.d: 這家電訊公司表示，有攻擊者利用自主AI工具於11月17日入侵，盜取企業客戶資料。

items.t: AI代理發現醫療影像伺服器零日漏洞
items.d: 攻擊者的AI代理在醫療影像工具MONAI Label發現未知漏洞，顯示AI正加快真實世界的入侵速度。

items.t: BADBOX殭屍網絡捲土重來 每日發出400億廣告請求
items.d: 這個藏於廉價Android電視盒等裝置的惡意網絡以破紀錄規模重現，用作廣告詐騙。宜避免使用無品牌串流盒。

items.t: SpaceX為美國國家偵察局發射間諜衛星
items.d: Falcon 9火箭從加州再發射一批國家偵察局衛星，屬美國迅速擴展中的偵察衛星群。

items.t: 美國麻疹個案創1991年來新高
items.d: 美國今年已錄得近5,840宗確診，疫苗接種率下降令疫情擴散。

items.t: AI影像系統及早識別深切治療部病人譫妄
items.d: 史丹福大學研究人員開發鏡頭系統監察深切治療部病人，及早發現醫護人員常忽略的譫妄徵狀。

items.t: AI及早預測三種妊娠併發症
items.d: Kaiser Permanente的模型可在懷孕較早階段預測先兆子癇等風險，讓醫生有更多時間處理。

items.t: 賓咸將會見伯明翰酒吧爆炸案家屬
items.d: 首相承諾會見1974年爆炸案21名死者的家屬，家屬要求由法官主持公開調查，會面預計明年初舉行。

items.t: 數百人倫敦遊行 要求收緊AI規管
items.d: 示威者周六遊行至唐寧街，引述科學家對先進AI風險的警告。

items.t: 英國10月借貸達170億英鎊
items.d: 為有紀錄以來第三高的10月數字，其中112億英鎊用於支付債務利息，令財相在預算案前的空間更緊。
